quickInfo.name: Five-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the three-bank to light a lock at the left-ramp trap door; the third lock releases five balls.

quickInfo.name: Swimmer Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: The left ramp, center ramp, upper VUK, right ramp, and spinner lane each collect a regular Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot doubler
quickInfo.summary: A spinner-lane ball is held in the upper launch for ten seconds, doubling regular Jackpot values during the hold.

quickInfo.name: Super Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: After five Jackpots, collect the SHARK scoop Super and side-ramp Double Super to light the 500M roving Baywatch Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Baywatch modes
quickInfo.summary: The fourth cumulative shot at any mode shot starts its 30-second vertical mode; across all five shots, lamp rows start Guard and Tourist Season.

quickInfo.name: Search & Rescue
quickInfo.summary: Complete all five vehicle standups to light a mystery award at the spinner; Tournament Mode fixes its award order.

steps.text: Use the opening save to test the three-bank rebounds, left-ramp trap door, five mode-shot returns, and shark-fin feed.
Complete the three-bank to light one or more locks at the left-ramp trap door.
Shoot the lit left ramp to lock a ball; repeat the displayed qualification until the third lock starts five-ball Multiball.
Collect the left-ramp, center-ramp, upper-VUK, right-ramp, and spinner-lane Swimmer Jackpots.
Use a spinner-lane hold to double remaining regular Jackpot values for ten seconds, but do not delay safer lit shots.
After all five Jackpots, collect the SHARK scoop Super and side-ramp Double Super, then follow the roving 500M Baywatch Jackpot.
modeNotes: Multiball ladder: Five mode-shot Jackpots, SHARK scoop Super, side-ramp Double Super, then the roving Baywatch Jackpot.

fallback.title: Vertical-mode route
fallback.when: Use this when drop-bank rebounds are dangerous but one mode shot returns safely.

steps.text: Choose the safest of the five mode shots.
Make its fourth cumulative hit to start the corresponding 30-second mode.
Follow that mode's lit shots only while their returns remain controlled.
After the timer, resume lock work or advance a different safe mode shot.

alternatives.title: Bonus and Search & Rescue
alternatives.when: Use this when top play is controllable but the drop bank and left ramp are not.

steps.text: Use the flippers to complete SPF and advance the bonus multiplier toward 10x.
Take safe vehicle standups until all five light Search & Rescue at the spinner.
Collect Search & Rescue only after confirming its Tournament Mode or normal-play award order.
Protect the multiplied bonus rather than forcing a rejecting lock shot.
Collect all five Multiball Jackpots and both Super Jackpots.
Follow the roving mode-shot sequence for the 500M Baywatch Jackpot.
Across normal play, finish all five vertical modes plus Guard and Tourist Season.
Start Earth Quake at the upper VUK and repeatedly collect the five lit mode-shot values.

cautions.response: Test each under ball save and switch routes when the next high-value shot cannot register safely.
